children: Bharti Airtel Limited (NSE:BHARTIARTL) reported September-quarter ARPU of Rs.271, ahead of Jio at Rs.218.8 and Vodafone Idea at Rs.198, and gained mobile-user and home-broadband market share alongside Jio. It is in advanced talks with Amazon Leo on a possible India partnership; terms remain unsettled.
: Bharti Airtel reported September-quarter ARPU of Rs.271, ahead of Jio at Rs.218.8 and Vodafone Idea at Rs.198. It also gained mobile-user and home-broadband market share alongside Jio.
: Bharti Airtel is in advanced talks with Amazon Leo on a possible India partnership. Airtel could manage Amazon Leo’s local infrastructure, including gateways; deal terms remain unsettled.
: Bharti Airtel or a new subsidiary may seek Indian telecom and security approvals for the partnership, with local operations under Indian control.
: Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Fund reduced its holding in Bharti Airtel Limited (BHARTIARTL) by ₹753 crore in October.
: Bharti Airtel logged 352,062 complaints about unsolicited calls and texts in July–September 2026; 186,013 were actionable. The carrier had 506.7 million active subscribers at quarter-end.
: As of September 30, 2026, 17.2% of Bharti Airtel Limited (BHARTIARTL) subscribers had registered Do Not Disturb preferences.
